_comment: Private auto-update config for the Studio App. 'repo' is the PRIVATE GitHub repo (owner/name) whose Releases hold the built EXE. 'token' is a fine-grained, READ-ONLY (Contents: Read) Personal Access Token scoped to ONLY that repo — it is left EMPTY here (never committed) and injected at build time by build_exe.py from the env var STEMTOABLETON_RELEASE_TOKEN or the local untracked file Studio App/release_token.local. Publishing is done with the `gh` CLI (Sam's own login); no publish token is baked in. This file can also be dropped NEXT TO the distributed EXE to repoint/rotate without a rebuild.
